quote: Automatic attribute value extraction aims to obtain structured product features from product profiles.
For each attribute, we calculate Precision/Recall/F1 based on exact string matching.
We use Macro-Precision/Macro-Recall/Macro-F1 ... as the aggregated metrics ...
For each attribute, we calculate Precision/Recall/F based on exact string matching.

we also manually annotated an additional testing set covering several attributes. We randomly selected 12 attributes from the 32 training attributes, took a random sample from the relevant product profiles for each attribute, and asked human annotators to annotate the corresponding values.
guideline: an extracted value is considered correct only if it exactly matches one of the ground truth values for the query attribute in the given text sequence.
